name: Canvas Area
description: Core bounded canvas engine (~1300 lines). Manages world-to-screen coordinate transform (screenX = worldX * scale + panX). Supports: left-click pan (except over cards), scroll wheel zoom (cursor-centered, 0.1x-5x range), grid rendering (dots/grid/none via canvas-grid utility, 28px pattern), snap-to-grid (28px for position and size). Card management: add/remove/minimize/terminate/reopen/focus with z-order stacking (auto-rebalance at 9998). Plugin lifecycle: Terminal (multi-instance, numbered), Explorer (singleton, split-pane), Markdown (singleton, tabbed viewer), Git (singleton), SpecsMap (singleton). Plugin list panel (lower-left hover zone) shows all cards sorted, with focus/reopen/terminate context menu. Arrange panel (lower-right hover zone): Auto Arrange (flow-layout), Tile Plugins (custom WxH grid units), Snap Origin. Layout zone overlays (9-zone grid) for snap-to-corner drag targets when locked at 1x. State serialization via getSaveState() → SaveState { plugins[], zOrder[], zoom, panX, panY, locked }. Restore handles legacy 'Dev'/'Explorer N' → 'Explorer' title normalization and deduplication. Animated pan via card-arranging CSS class. Status bar integration via StatusBar class. World coordinate clamping (±50000px bounds).
